attacks.attack: 1. Rewrite a failure as a success
attacks.detail: keep-commitment -> blob_intact=False; forge-commitment -> merkle_inclusion=False. A failure cannot be silently turned into a success under the signed root.

attacks.attack: 2. Drop a failed attempt from an anchored batch
attacks.detail: dropping item #1 yields root sha256:8b8f745fa3a… != pinned sha256:2295e9501d4… -> rejected against the pinned root. ACCEPTED LIMIT: omission BEFORE ingestion (an event that never enters the batch) cannot be proven absent by the spine alone — needs heartbeat/sequence (P1+).

attacks.attack: 3. Launder a failure via a forged 'successful retry'
attacks.detail: forged retry under signed root -> included=False (rejected); the original failure leaf still verifies (blob_intact=True). A retry NEVER deletes the prior failure — recovery is append-only, not erasure.

forbidden/over-claim hits: none; honest_limits present: True; non-success records still counted in histogram: 10. Artifacts record failures as failures and disclose limits — recovery is not sold as erasure.
